title: The Microbial Diversity and Biofilm Characteristics of d -PTFE Membranes Used for Socket Preservation: A Randomized Controlled Clinical Trial Franović, B., Čandrlić, M., Blašković, M
authors: Renko, I., Komar Milas, K., Markova -Car, E. P., Mohar Vitezić, B., Gabrić, D., Gobin, I., Vranić, S. M., Perić Kačarević, Ž., & Peloza, O. C. (2025). Journal of Functional Biomaterials, 16(2), 40.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss permamem (dense PTFE) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “This study highlights the distinct microbial profiles of two d -PTFE membranes during the four-week socket preservation period. Therefore, the membrane type and design do, indeed, influence the biofilm composition and microbial diversity. These findings ma y have implications for healing outcomes and the risk of infection in the dental implant bed and should therefore be further explored” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
